_meta.adr: ADR-037 fragment — additive overlays for T1 Account.isSuspenseAccount per REQ-BR-007 (suspense-account designation, design.md D3) without editing the shillinq_register.json monolith.
_meta.description: Bank-reconciliation overlay for the suspense-account designation decision (design.md D3): adds an additive `isSuspenseAccount` boolean to T1's Account schema so the bookkeeper can flag exactly one Account per administration (or per bank account) as the bank-reconciliation suspense account. Unmatched lines route to this account via the BankStatementLine `routed-to-suspense` lifecycle action. The T2 GLTransaction materialisation is declarative per the same T1 pattern — no PHP service is authored. Existing Account fields are unchanged.

isSuspenseAccount.description: When true, this Account is the designated bank-reconciliation suspense account for the administration. Unmatched BankStatementLine rows materialise a balanced GLTransaction debiting/crediting the bank-account GL against this account when the operator marks a line `routed-to-suspense`. A non-zero suspense balance is reportable through trial balance and surfaced as a follow-up flag in the bank-rec UI.
isSuspenseAccount.title: Is Suspense Account
